blocks.html:
This method updates a product option. It sends a request to the
[Update Option](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-options\_postproductoptionsid)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The data to update in the option.

children.name: id
children.description: The option's ID.

children.name: title
children.description: The option's title.

children.name: values
children.description: The option's values.

children.name: ranks
children.description:
The rank for each option value. The keys are the option values,
and the values are their respective ranks.

children.name: is_exclusive
children.description:
Whether the option is exclusive to a specific product,
or can be shared across multiple products.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Key-value pairs of custom data.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the option.
